NOW THEREFORE, Seller and Developer agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions.As used herein: Property in excess of 116,575 square feet. Additional Development Rights shall include any BSA Development Rights actually obtained by Developer pursuant to a Special Permit but shall not include Floor Area made available to the Property by virtue of an Upzoning. In the event of a New Building, the calculation of “Additional Development Rights” shall equal the Floor Area of the New Building (except for any Floor Area from an Upzoning) minus 116,575 square feet. Notwithstanding the foregoing, in the event of an Enlargement, the calculation of “Additional Development Rights" shall not include any Floor Area actually utilized by the Buildings prior to such Enlargement, even if such Floor Area utilized by the Buildings exceeds 116,575 sf.
